name: MRC Agrotech Limited
about: MRC Agrotech Limited engages in the cultivation, manufacturing, production, export, and sale of agriculture products in India. The company offers cinnamon, palmarosa, Ajwain, lemon grass, and peppermint essential oils, as well as lemon grass chunks and tea-cuts. It also provides pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, and herbal products; Temi tea; NANO urea, NANO potash, NANO copper, NANO zinc, and Nano manganese; cotton, maize, mustard, paddy, and wheat seeds; guar-based food and feed ingredients; and fruit-based and specialty food products. The company was formerly known as MRC Exim Limited and changed its name to MRC Agrotech Limited in March 2022. MRC Agrotech Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Mumbai, India.
